summary_zh.motivation: 设计具有渐变微结构的多孔股骨假体以降低剪切应力和骨质吸收。
summary_zh.method: 通过形状插值生成微结构集，结合应变能约束优化，并用SLM制造原型。

summary_en.motivation: To design porous femoral implants with spatially varying microstructures that reduce shear stress at the bone-prosthesis interface and constrain bone resorption.
summary_en.method: A shape interpolation method generates microstructure sets, combined with optimization under strain energy constraint, and a prototype is fabricated via selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: Designs with varying microstructures outperform homogeneous ones, and the choice of microstructure set significantly affects the optimized implant design.
summary_en.validation: Design performance is verified through numerical optimization, and manufacturability is demonstrated by an SLM-fabricated metal prototype.

title: Adaptive Design of Experiments for Conservative Estimation of Excursion Sets
relevance_to_user: 该方法直接针对昂贵仿真模型的采样效率问题，使用高斯过程代理模型和序贯不确定性缩减策略，可迁移至植入物力学设计中的阈值区域估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any example or validation related to biomedical implant mechanics or biomechanics; it only demonstrates on a reliability engineering test case.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低昂贵仿真中估计系统行为区域的采样成本。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程模型和序贯不确定性缩减准则自适应选择新评估点。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of estimating regions (excursion sets) where an expensive simulation exceeds a threshold.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process-based adaptive design of experiments strategy using stepwise uncertainty reduction criteria to sequentially select new evaluations for conservative excursion set estimation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive performance on both model-generated random functions and a reliability engineering test case.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on random functions and a reliability engineering case study.

summary_zh.validation: 通过标准可靠性测试案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently perform reliability analysis for systems with multiple failure modes using surrogate models.
summary_en.method: An active learning Kriging surrogate model is proposed with a learning function tailored for multiple failure modes.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces the number of expensive simulations while accurately identifying failure domains in several numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard reliability benchmark problems.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the osseointegration of Ti6Al4V scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting after surface treatment.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V scaffolds were manufactured via selective laser melting and subsequently subjected to surface treatment.
summary_en.result: The surface treatment significantly enhanced osseointegration of the scaffolds.
summary_en.validation: Osseointegration was validated through in vivo animal implantation experiments.

summary_en.motivation: To understand the role of micromotion and fluid flow at the bone-implant interface in aseptic loosening of cementless femoral stems.
summary_en.method: A micro-CT based technique using radiopaque markers was developed to measure full-field micromotion, and a poroelastic finite element model was used to predict fluid flow from measured micromotion.
summary_en.result: The first full-field map of micromotion around a cementless femoral stem was obtained, and fluid velocity and shear stress distributions in peri-implant tissues were predicted.
summary_en.validation: The micromotion measurement technique was validated in cadaveric femurs against LVDT measurements.

summary_en.motivation: To enable just-in-time customization of patient-specific AM prostheses within a single surgical procedure while minimizing mass and matching bone stiffness.
summary_en.method: A design approach using raw CT scan data and lattice structures is applied to the additive manufacture of femoral prostheses.

summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression testing of fabricated lattice structures.

summary_zh.validation: 尸体实验验证，高精度位移传感器测量

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of distal stem taper angle on initial axial stability of press-fit metaphyseal-fixed THA stems.
summary_en.method: Cadaveric specimens were implanted with stems of 3.5° and 5° taper angles and subjected to simulated walking gait loading up to 2.5× body weight; stem axial displacement was measured with a high-resolution digital indicator.
summary_en.result: Both stem designs exhibited high initial stability with bone-implant motion less than 30 μm, and no statistically significant difference between designs was found.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using fresh-frozen matched-pair cadaveric specimens with controlled loading and high-precision displacement measurements.

title: Efficient Uncertainty Quantification for Large-Scale Biomechanical Models Using a Bayesian Multi-Fidelity Approach
venue: mediaTUM – the media and publications repository of the Technical University Munich (Technical University Munich)
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对生物力学模型中的不确定性量化问题，提出了贝叶斯多保真度方法，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant-specific design optimization or contact mechanics, and the applications are limited to AAA and lung models rather than hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物力学模型参数不确定，传统UQ方法计算成本高，需要高效框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯多保真度采样框架，利用低保真模型信息加速UQ。
summary_zh.result: 成功应用于腹主动脉瘤和肺模型，实现概率预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟案例验证，未涉及实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: Parametric uncertainties in large-scale biomechanical models are computationally prohibitive to quantify with traditional methods, motivating a more efficient framework.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian multi-fidelity approach is developed that leverages cheap low-fidelity models sharing stochastic structure with high-fidelity models to propagate uncertainties.
summary_en.result: The framework enables probabilistic predictions and error bars for patient-specific models of abdominal aortic aneurysms and reduced-order lung models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies without experimental or clinical data.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the difference in micromotion predicted by static versus dynamic loading conditions in cementless THA.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was performed on a Profemur®TL stem implanted in a composite bone under static and dynamic stair-climbing loads.
